_meta.what: The random Vision Cards a summoned Neo Vision unit came with on Global, each from the day it joined the summon pool (player_state.nv_summon_vision_card). A unit's own card came from EX awakening (EX+1/EX+3, F_NV_EX_CLASS_UP_MST), not from the summon. See ios-server/research/NV_VISION_CARDS.md.
